description: POST one page URL on a site you own or are authorized to audit. Returns on-page SEO as JSON: title, meta description, canonical, noindex, robots.txt and sitemap status, headings, images missing alt, links, schema.org types, hreflang, Open Graph, coded issues and a 0-100 score. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].

authorized.description: Must be true: you own this site or are authorized to audit it

checkSitemap.description: Read the sitemap to report whether the page is listed

url.description: Public http(s) page URL to audit

name: seo_audit
